cohort: 121 newborn infants born at or after 36 weeks gestation, ventilated for poor perinatal adaptation or hypoxic ischaemic encephalopathy without respiratory disease, and admitted to a tertiary neonatal unit between 2014-2022.
finding: Chest radiographic thoracic area (CRTA) was significantly related to birth weight, gestation at birth, and birth weight z-score.
